verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant work directly inside the Thoropass workspace, within limits the user sets. Documented tools cover listing audits, viewing evidence requests, and adding comments, attachments and status updates, and the user can choose which tools the agent gets. The help article was also confirmed by a probe. Missing for 10: detailed connection/auth setup and supported-client specifics in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Thoropass MCP server lets your AI assistant help with that work right where you're already working, so you don't have to export data and upload it somewhere else.
MCP lets the assistant work directly inside your Thoropass workspace, within limits you set.
List audits and view audit details ... List evidence requests, view their details, and see the systems tied to them
Add comments, attachments, and status updates to evidence requests
Add or remove the last three depending on what you want your agent to be able to do.
